profile_text.body:
Hesai Group is a Shanghai-headquartered public company, traded under the ticker HSAI, that describes itself as a global leader in 3D perception and a global leader in lidar solutions for ADAS and autonomous mobility. According to its own site, the company builds lidar sensors intended to enable physical AI across ADAS, autonomous mobility, robotics, and spatial intelligence. It says its sensors support functions including Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB), NOA (Navigate on Autopilot), and semi-autonomous driving, and that they meet the standards it associates with L4+ autonomous driving for robotaxis and robobuses.

The company states that it partners with leading OEMs, autonomous vehicle companies, and robotics companies worldwide, and that it has delivered mass-produced lidars to customers in over 40 countries. It positions its lidar work as serving ADAS, autonomous vehicles, trucking, and industrial applications, and as supporting reliability and safety in those uses. These are the company's own descriptions of its market position.

The record held on the company lists no litigation and no tracked products. Its registration details identify it as a for-profit public company with CIK 0001861737, headquartered in Shanghai, with the website hesaitech.com.
